gotchas.text: Prefill and needle workloads reuse prompts within a run, so any engine with prefix caching on reports cache-hit latency as prefill. Measure prefill with caching disabled, as this cell does, or compare only against another caching-disabled cell.

vllm/vllm-openai:v0.27.1-aarch64 cannot serve Gemma 4 as shipped: transformers 5.15.0 raises AmbiguousGlobalPerLayerAttributeError on head_dim. Pinning transformers==5.8.1 inside the container is what made this run possible.

The haystack generator sizes context by chars/4, which overshoots Gemma tokenization by about 1.2-1.3x: a 131072-token target sends roughly 158k real tokens and is rejected by a 131072-token window, so the 128k workloads cannot pass at this max-model-len.

provenance.notes: NVIDIA DGX Spark (ASUS Ascent GX10, GB10) on Ubuntu 24.04 / DGX OS, driver 580.173.02, CUDA 13.0. Same server as the prefix-caching-on cell on this machine (vLLM 0.27.1, stock vllm/vllm-openai:v0.27.1-aarch64 with transformers pinned to 5.8.1, TRITON_ATTN forced by Gemma 4 heterogeneous head dimensions, thinking off by chat-template default), with one change: --no-enable-prefix-caching. This cell exists because the prefill and needle workloads reuse prompts, so with vLLM's default prefix caching on they measure cache hits rather than prefill: on this machine prefill-8k returned 1057ms cold and 68ms warm for the same prompt, and all six longctx-needle-32k retrievals were cache hits. These numbers are cold prefill. The DeepSeek-v4-Flash service normally resident on this machine was stopped for the duration of the run.
